searchText: State Sync #49 - <@830368514225340436> has been working on improving the diff generation (specifically not generating diffs for unchanged files.) - <@689161464829050960> has been working on polishing the Istanbul PR (removing `CHAIN_ID` and loading it from the genesis file.) - <@243183686562873344> Porting the optimized state to Rust and adding a flag to use it for pytest. Huh, <@243183686562873344> <@830368514225340436>, are there no tests for Muir Glacier? There are difficulty tests https://github.com/ethereum/tests/tree/develop/DifficultyTests/dfEIP2384, can't see why any other type of test could be worth it since Muir Glacier is a one line change to the difficulty formula. I saw those, but they're under `Berlin`? `tests/DifficultyTests/dfEIP2384/` doesn't seem to be "under Berlin" to me. I don't understand the structure of the test JSON, so I might be worried about nothing ^^;; Berlin has the same difficulty rules as Muir Glacier and it's a bit of a pseudofork (doesn't even exist on POA). Ah, so I'll just not make a tests dir for Muir. I think `muir_glacier` should not have a test directory in the same way as `dao_fork`. Ideally I'd like to get the code coverage up to 100%, but that's a long term goal. Does the coverage tool have an exclude option? 🙃
